RAG (Read-Answer-Generate) is a novel approach to question answering that combines the strengths of extractive and abstractive models. By leveraging the accuracy of RAG even when the correct answer is not present in retrieved documents, it achieves an impressive 11.8% accuracy in such cases. This is particularly notable given that the models used for training and testing, such as BART, have a 0% accuracy rate.

RAG outperforms BART on Open MS-MARCO NLG by a significant margin, with a 2.6-point improvement in Bleu and 2.6-point improvement in Rouge-L scores. This demonstrates the effectiveness of RAG in generating high-quality answers, even when the correct information is not readily available.
